description: Today, Michael Whatley hosted a Make More Keep More Press Conference in Benson alongside local business owners and family farmers. They discussed Whatley’s commitment to protecting a strong economy, especially for our family farmers that faced higher costs under Roy Cooper. Under Cooper’s watch, energy prices increased by 30% and input costs soared, all while Cooper’s family made millions on a sweetheart solar deal.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Whatley for Senate
title: Michael Whatley hosts Make More Keep More Press Conference in Benson with Farmers and Local Business Owners – Michael Whatley for Senate
